fact.claim: Cipher Digital (CIFR, formerly Cipher Mining) closed at $6.55 on Nov 6, 2026. That is about 58% lower than a month earlier, and its 52-week range is $5.07 to $30.14. On Nov 2, 2026 the company reported Q3 revenue of about $27 million, which included its first HPC lease revenue. It also said its Barber Lake lease now runs 20 years and carries about $9.1 billion of total contracted revenue. Contracted revenue is rent due over the full lease term, not money already earned, and it depends on Cipher delivering the data center capacity on schedule.
